newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokuyo City Bank sharply higher in morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokuyo City Bank sharply higher in morning trade.

text.p: Tokuyo City Bank Ltd shares were sharply higher in Monday morning trade due to a feeling in the market that they were oversold, brokers said.
As of 0053 GMT, the shares were up 11 yen at 195 yen, the largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
"From mid-November, some banks' shares have been under heavy heavy selling pressure and are now at a level where they are oversold, which is encouraging buy-backs," a second-tier trader said.
